description: Answers 'ask a question or leave a note on this strategy.' Give a slug and a body (1-2000 characters) - a question, a result from a fork, or a suggested change. Returns the posted comment and the strategy's page URL. Posts a public comment under your handle. If the slug is unknown or private, the error says so - call list_strategies to find a public strategy.
name: comment_strategy
title: Comment on a hub strategy
